title: The Well of the Ninth Floor
author: Sebastian Marchetti
blurb: Zephyrine Marchetti, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
